questions.question: Seven people H, I, J, K, L, M, and N are sitting in a row facing the north. Only two people are seated to the left of L. Only three people are seated between L and H. I is seated second to the right of J. I is not an immediate neighbour of H. K is seated to the immediate right of M. Who is seated at the extreme left end of the row?
questions.solution:
Logic followed here is.

Based on the given information, seven people are seated in a row facing **North**. We will place them step-by-step according to the constraints provided.

**Step 1:** Only two people are seated to the left of **L**. This means **L** is at the **3rd position** from the left end.

**Step 2:** Only three people are seated between **L** and **H**. Counting three positions to the right of **L** (4th, 5th, and 6th), **H** must be at the **7th position** (extreme right end).

**Step 3:** **I** is seated second to the right of **J** (Pattern: **J _ I**). Also, **I** is not an immediate neighbor of **H**, so **I** cannot be at the 6th position. The only valid placement for this pair is **J** at the **2nd position** and **I** at the **4th position**.

**Step 4:** **K** is seated to the immediate right of **M** (Pattern: **MK**). The only available adjacent seats are the **5th** and **6th** positions. Thus, **M** is at the 5th and **K** is at the 6th position.

**Step 5:** The only remaining person, **N**, is placed in the only vacant spot, which is the **1st position** (extreme left end).

**The Final Seating Arrangement is:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19786ca1d11b64073d7eedaa367aebd868a5603ea77f5010efe604ccf2b47cb8.png] 

By observing the final arrangement, we can see that **N** is seated at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f90629ded314bb0e14b5a3858b257b8b0dacaef39fe12f0e0f1d942756ee926.png] 

The logic followed here is

Logic: **First letter of the first cluster + 4 = First letter of the second cluster**; **Second letter of the first cluster + 4 = Second letter of the second cluster**.

Option 1) **MP − RT**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc9bf74a1fe166fe311a6d90036db9586c45f08af036b25d10b0692b39e5aa3a.png] 

**M + 5 = R and P + 4 = T. This pair does not follow the (+4, +4) rule.**

Option 2) **QT − UX**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f34d8f077f9a0eb61cf1374a51e041685de0d1a6854f20de2d6a27203b87a9.png] 

Option 3) **JM − NQ**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2db1a241e65168cf7ae9e8bea0a65435e956d0679e48f1edc32171a9adf9758f.png] 

Option 4) **PS − TW**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7a733715d7f2699bed103c5ff1f79d1d63c19aa789f1c406a4b5a048fe260fd.png] 

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair that is different from the others is **MP − RT**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
